title: Tokenization — Length Is Measured in Tokens
key_insight: Context limits and API charges are usually counted in tokens. Inspect token counts before truncating, batching, or promising a maximum document size.
body:
## Length Is Measured in Tokens

Two prompts have the same character count, yet one costs twice as much because its language and symbols split into more pieces.

Context limits and API charges are usually counted in tokens. Inspect token counts before truncating, batching, or promising a maximum document size.

Normalization and whitespace rules can change tokenization. Preserve the same preprocessing in training and serving, especially for code and multilingual text.
common_mistakes: A tokenizer directly verifies every factual answer.
Every token is always one complete English word.
Token numbers have the same meaning across all models.
mini_exercise: Draw “Length Is Measured in Tokens” as three labeled steps, then explain what changes at each step.
real_world_usage: Every language-model input and output passes through a tokenizer, so its choices affect meaning, length, and cost.
explain_back_prompt: Using “Length Is Measured in Tokens,” explain Tokenization without assuming the listener knows modern AI.
